entities.summary: Fatima-Zohra Oukazi is an Algerian international volleyball player and Algeria women's national volleyball team captain (2010-2012), playing as setter. At club level she made her debut for GS Chlef, based in her home city of Chlef. She now plays for Algiers' based GS Petroliers.
